name: craft
description: What does good code look like? Sixteen one-page engineering principles from Lauren Tan's pstack (type-system discipline, model the domain, minimize reader load, boundary discipline, idempotent operations, build the lever, test behavior not implementation, subtract before you add and more), plus code-level practice: karpathy-coder and ponytail for the smallest correct change, error-handling-patterns, performance-optimization, deprecation-and-migration, source-driven-development, constraint-driven-development, ai-development-guide, prototype for a throwaway answer to one design question, and oh-my-issues for clustering an issue backlog by root cause. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
